versions.changelog:
Initial release of murasame-feishu-voice

- Adds Feishu voice bubble support with Murasame voicepack, automating voice & text messaging.
- Supports label-based voice responses with customizable mapping and keyword fallback.
- Allows manual on/off voice toggle by command or environment variable.
- Handles async voice sending alongside immediate Chinese text delivery.
- Designed for emotion-rich Feishu chats while retaining readable text.
